retrievalProfile.description: A moody 1970s-style portrait featuring a central figure with an acoustic guitar, characterized by heavy dark vignettes, dramatic lens flares, and multi-line geometric custom lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key portrait of a musician holding an acoustic guitar, set against a near-black background with intense, multi-pointed starburst lens flares emanating from reflective points on the clothing and instrument. The composition is topped with stylized, multi-line geometric lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure emerging from deep shadow
High contrast between dark background and bright white guitar body
Geometric typography anchored at the top center
Diagonal light streaks creating a sense of movement
coreInvariants: Heavy dark vignette obscuring the background
Multi-line inline stroke effect on primary display text
Cross-shaped lens flares with long, thin rays

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male figure, centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white body of the acoustic guitar in the lower left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright guitar, follow the lens flare rays upward to the subject's face, and finally to the stylized text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark, textured negative space surrounding the subject on all sides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black background tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and pale pink on the guitar and skin tones
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold and tan in the typography and hair highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in specific highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Characters are composed of multiple parallel thin lines (inline effect)
Heavy emphasis on verticality and sharp angles
The 'M' and 'A' feature exaggerated, elongated strokes that interlock
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' uses four parallel diagonal lines to form its legs
The 'A' is a sharp triangle with horizontal striations
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly decorative geometric display text paired with a widely spaced, arched minimalist sans-serif.

preserve: Wide tracking on the top line

candidateDirections.reason: For the arched subtitle text skeleton
For the multi-line inline display effect

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a man with 70s-style wavy hair holding an acoustic guitar. Use a dark, textured background with heavy vignetting. Add 4-6 bright, multi-pointed starburst lens flares on the guitar strings and the man's shirt buttons.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom multi-line geometric lettering for the main name in the top center. Above it, place a secondary title in a wide-tracked, light sans-serif font following a gentle upward arch.

verificationChecks: Is the main text composed of multiple parallel lines?
Are there prominent starburst lens flares?
Is the background nearly black with a visible texture?
Is the guitar the brightest object in the lower half?

adjustableVariables: Number of lines in the inline typography

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn quality to the multi-line text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'M' and 'A' in the display text are stylized and interlocking.
Ensure the lens flares have long, thin, distinct rays.
Verify the background is dark enough to make the white guitar pop.
Confirm the top text follows a curved path.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key portrait + multi-line geometric display type + starburst flares + heavy vignette = 70s soft rock aesthetic.
